entities.name: T3448 value
entities.description: Timer value IE that may be included by the network when congestion control for transport of user data via the control plane is active and the UE supports control plane CIoT 5GS optimizations.

entities.name: Congestion control for transport of user data via the control plane is active
entities.description: Condition indicating that congestion control for user data transport via control plane is currently active.

entities.name: UE supports control plane CIoT 5GS optimizations
entities.description: Condition indicating that the UE supports control plane CIoT 5GS optimization features.

relations.description: Inclusion of T3448 value IE is conditional upon congestion control for user data transport via control plane being active.
